visual_description: A sleek, professional air compressor with twin white vertical tanks. The motor is encased in a sound-muffling shroud. A digital pressure gauge glows blue, showing '90 PSI'. It features a clear glass bowl on the side (the moisture trap) and a series of brass regulators.

constraints.material: Powder-coated white steel; braided stainless steel lead lines.
constraints.logic: The power source for all Preparator tools. Must be 'drained' of water daily.
